title: Coffee is Life
statementMd:
On his voyage to hunt the elusive white whale, Captain Ahab is swamped with tasks to do during day-to-day life on his ship. The good news is that he has the life-sustaining power of coffee on his side. The bad news is that there is a limited amount of coffee in his ship's hold. There are n days, each with some amount of work wi to do. Each unit of work costs 1 energy, and every day starts with 0 energy.

There are m cups of coffee that can be drunk on any day. The first coffee drunk on any day gives k energy, the second gives k−1 energy, and so on, until the kth coffee gives 1 energy; any coffee drunk afterward gives no energy.

Ahab needs your help to ration his coffee to complete as much work as possible.

## Input

The first line of input contains n, m, and k (1≤n≤105,1≤m,k≤109), the number of days, cups of coffee, and initial energy from coffee, respectively.

The second line contains n integers, w1,w2,...,wn (1≤wi≤1018), the amount of work to be done each day.

## Output

The output should be one line containing the maximum possible amount of work that can be done.

## Note

It is optimal for Ahab to drink two coffees on the first day, one on the second day, and one on the third day for 5+2+3=10 units of work total.
